PACK.text:
Direct Instruction lesson script
Grade 1  ·  2 words  ·  1 activities

OBJECTIVE
Given 2 words built on the /or/ sound spelled or, students will hear and work with the separate sounds in spoken words, with 3 consecutive correct responses per item.

About 12 minutes. Mastery: 3 consecutive correct.

MATERIALS
  - The word list in this script, on the table or on the board.
  - The device running Word Sounds, with this pack loaded.
  - The lesson plan you built, in this order.
  - Somewhere to mark which items were missed. The correction procedure depends on you remembering them.

----------------------------------------
SOUND WARM-UP  (2 min)
Get the sounds in this lesson fluent before any word is read.

  SAY: We are warming up our sounds. When I point, you say the sound.
  SAY: My turn first. /or/.
  SAY: Your turn.
  DO:  Show or say each sound below. Keep it fast. Aim for about one sound per second.
  DO:  Any sound the group is slow on is the one to model again before you start.

    /or/   r-controlled vowel, in 2 words (medial)
    /n/   single consonant, in 2 words (final)
    /h/   single consonant, in 1 word (initial)
    /k/   single consonant, in 1 word (initial)

----------------------------------------
MODEL. "MY TURN"  (3 min)
The child watches. They do not respond yet.

  SAY: Watch me. I am going to say the sounds in this word, then say the word.
  SAY: /k/ /or/ /n/. Corn.
  SAY: Watch me. I am going to say the sounds in this word, then say the word.
  SAY: /h/ /or/ /n/. Horn.
  DO:  Do every step yourself, out loud, at normal speed.
  DO:  Two examples are enough. A third is usually one too many.

    corn   /k/ /or/ /n/  ·  CVC  ·  r-controlled
    horn   /h/ /or/ /n/  ·  CVC  ·  r-controlled

----------------------------------------
LEAD. "TOGETHER"  (4 min)
You and the child do it at the same time. Your voice fades as theirs holds.

  SAY: Say it with me. Ready.
  SAY: /k/ /or/ /n/. Corn.
  SAY: /h/ /or/ /n/. Horn.
  SAY: Again, a little faster.
  DO:  Say it with them. Drop your volume on the second and third repetition.
  DO:  Stay on this step until the group is together. Moving on early is what produces the errors you then have to correct.

    corn   /k/ /or/ /n/  ·  CVC
    horn   /h/ /or/ /n/  ·  CVC

----------------------------------------
YOUR TURN 1. SOUND COUNTING  (1 min)
Count the sounds in a spoken word.
Strand: Phonemic awareness

  SAY: My turn. Corn. /k/ /or/ /n/. Three sounds.
  SAY: Your turn. How many sounds do you hear in corn?
  DO:  The child works in the app. You watch and score, you do not prompt unless there is an error.
  DO:  Watch for: A child who counts letters. Digraphs are where this shows up.

    corn   /k/ /or/ /n/  ·  3 sounds
    horn   /h/ /or/ /n/  ·  3 sounds

----------------------------------------
CORRECTION PROCEDURE
Use this the moment an error happens, not at the end.

  Model: "Listen. This one is ___."
        Give the answer immediately. Do not let the child keep guessing.
  Lead: "Say it with me. ___."
        Say it together until it is smooth. Two or three times is normal.
  Test: "Your turn. ___?"
        The child answers alone. If it is still wrong, model again.
  Delayed test: "Come back to it after two or three other items."
        An item is only fixed when it is right after a gap.
  * Do not say "no" or "wrong". Give the answer, practise it together, then hand it back.
  * Keep the pace brisk. Long pauses after an error are what turn a small miss into a large one.
  * Mastery for this lesson is 3 consecutive correct on an item before moving on.

----------------------------------------
CHECK AND CLOSE  (2 min)
Decide what happens tomorrow before the child leaves the table.

  SAY: Let me hear these two again.
  SAY: Tell me one word you can read now that you could not read before.
  DO:  Re-test two items the child missed earlier. Those are the ones that tell you whether the lesson held.
  DO:  Any correspondence still wrong after correction goes into the next warm-up.
  DO:  A child at 3 consecutive correct across the set is ready for the next pattern. Below that, reteach this one.

----------------------------------------
WORD LIST
  corn   /k/ /or/ /n/   3 sounds   CVC   r-controlled
  horn   /h/ /or/ /n/   3 sounds   CVC   r-controlled

BEFORE YOU TEACH THIS
